graph_adjacency_image — CONNGRAPH view op

• Data kinds: conn_graph → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.graph_adjacency_image(W: 'Any', order: 'str' = 'none', log: 'bool' = True) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import conngraph; conngraph.graph_adjacency_image(W: 'Any', order: 'str' = 'none', log: 'bool' = True) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsconngraph.get("graph_adjacency_image"))

Usage

Turns the adjacency matrix into an image (n, n) in [0, 1]. order = none / degree (descending total degree) / component (component order).

The value is |W| (after log1p if log) divided by its maximum. If all zero, an all-zero image.
